title: Beyond Models: A Framework for Contextual and Cultural Intelligence in African AI Deployment

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing real-world user conversations to measure the system's recognition of explicit cultural intelligence signals, including family-focused commerce patterns, local geographic and product knowledge, and culturally-appropriate relationship-building language.

Evaluating the system's natural language understanding and ability to naturally process code-switching and multilingual interactions (e.g., mixing English, Shona, and Ndebele) without requiring explicit language specification.

Assessing the AI's sensitivity to economic vulnerability in user queries and evaluating adoption rates of low-bandwidth, mobile-first interfaces (WhatsApp) compared to traditional web platforms that assume high-speed internet and data abundance.
